newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sewoo Polymer in 19-for-100 rights.
newsitem.headline: Sewoo Polymer in 19-for-100 rights.

text.p: South Korea's Sewoo Polymer Co Ltd said on Wednesday it is planning a 19-for-100 rights issue in October to raise operating funds.
Sewoo will issue 350,000 new common shares, 20 percent of which will be offered to employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders as of October 25.
Subscription is set for October 29 and 30, with payment due by November 26.
The rights issue will be made at a 25 percent discount to a base issue price to be announced at a later date.
With the rights issue offer, the company's paid-in capital will rise to nine billion won from 7.25 billion.
Sewoo shares were up 100 won at 10,700 in early trading on Wednesday.
